services.value: Eurofins Environment Testing provides environmental testing services such as air and vapor, built environment testing, general environment services, ground and surface water testing, industrial hygiene, metals and metals speciation, microplastics, municipal and drinking water, PFAS testing, sediment and tissue, soil and hazardous waste, and specialty services. It also offers support for waste management including groundwater and leachate monitoring and landfill gas and ambient air testing, as well as RCRA characteristic testing and waste characterization methods such as TCLP, SPLP, and CA WET.
